policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS a viewer sees inside it (data scope). They are administered separately.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen - "sees 1,158 of 3,098" - is derived from the approved profile roster at paint time, never typed.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one basis field plus optional masks.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row (business, facility, state, process).

policies.name: Quote confidentiality
policies.desc: A quote in draft is visible to the account team and Technical Solutions only, until it is sent to the generator.

policies.name: Correspondence is runtime
policies.desc: Mailbox content is read at question time under the reader's permissions and never becomes a graph fact or a cached figure.

policies.name: A permitted code is not an outlet
policies.desc: An outlet is a permitted unit with capacity in the period that meets the customer requirement; a permit, a plan or a letter is quoted as a statement with its date.

policies.name: Goals act only on approval
policies.desc: A goal drafts notices and lists; anything sent, booked or moved outside the product waits for the person who owns the goal.
